plugins.label: Holographic DNA
plugins.author: community
plugins.description: Vertical double-helix DNA strand with holographic glow, rotating rungs, and soft neon trails. Fully procedural Cairo drawing.
plugins.lua_draw_body:
local cx = {cx}
local y0 = {y}
local H = {height}
local amp = {amplitude}
local turns = {turns}
local n_rung = math.max(2, math.floor({rung_count}))
local spin = {spin_speed} * wall_clock()
local ar, ag, ab = {color_a}
local br, bg, bb = {color_b}
local rr, rg, rb = {rung_color}
local glow = {glow}
local lw = {line_width}
local opacity = {opacity}
local steps = math.max(40, math.floor(H / 3))

local function helix_xy(t, phase)
  local ang = t * turns * 2 * math.pi + spin + phase
  local x = cx + math.cos(ang) * amp
  local y = y0 + t * H
  local z = math.sin(ang)
  return x, y, z
end

-- soft vertical aura
if glow then
  for g = 3, 1, -1 do
    cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, ar, ag, ab, opacity * (0.04 / g))
    cairo_set_line_width(cr, amp * 0.35 * g)
    cairo_move_to(cr, cx, y0)
    cairo_line_to(cr, cx, y0 + H)
    cairo_stroke(cr)
  end
end

-- rungs (base pairs) — draw first so strands sit on top
for i = 0, n_rung - 1 do
  local t = (i + 0.5) / n_rung
  local x1, y1, z1 = helix_xy(t, 0)
  local x2, y2, z2 = helix_xy(t, math.pi)
  local depth = (z1 + z2) * 0.5
  local a = opacity * (0.35 + 0.55 * (0.5 + 0.5 * depth))
  if glow then
    cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, rr, rg, rb, a * 0.35)
    cairo_set_line_width(cr, lw * 2.2)
    cairo_move_to(cr, x1, y1)
    cairo_line_to(cr, x2, y2)
    cairo_stroke(cr)
  end
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, rr, rg, rb, a)
  cairo_set_line_width(cr, lw * 0.85)
  cairo_move_to(cr, x1, y1)
  cairo_line_to(cr, x2, y2)
  cairo_stroke(cr)
  -- nucleotide dots
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, ar, ag, ab, a)
  cairo_arc(cr, x1, y1, lw * 1.1, 0, 2 * math.pi)
  cairo_fill(cr)
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, br, bg, bb, a)
  cairo_arc(cr, x2, y2, lw * 1.1, 0, 2 * math.pi)
  cairo_fill(cr)
end

-- strand polylines (back-to-front by sampling depth)
local function draw_strand(phase, cr_, cg_, cb_)
  -- collect points
  local pts = {}
  for i = 0, steps do
    local t = i / steps
    local x, y, z = helix_xy(t, phase)
    pts[#pts + 1] = {x, y, z}
  end
  -- glow pass
  if glow then
    cairo_set_line_cap(cr, CAIRO_LINE_CAP_ROUND)
    cairo_set_line_join(cr, CAIRO_LINE_JOIN_ROUND)
    for g = 2, 1, -1 do
      cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, cr_, cg_, cb_, opacity * (0.12 / g))
      cairo_set_line_width(cr, lw * (2.8 + g))
      cairo_new_path(cr)
      for i, p in ipairs(pts) do
        if i == 1 then cairo_move_to(cr, p[1], p[2]) else cairo_line_to(cr, p[1], p[2]) end
      end
      cairo_stroke(cr)
    end
  end
  -- main strand with depth-modulated alpha segments
  cairo_set_line_cap(cr, CAIRO_LINE_CAP_ROUND)
  cairo_set_line_width(cr, lw)
  for i = 1, #pts - 1 do
    local a = opacity * (0.45 + 0.55 * (0.5 + 0.5 * pts[i][3]))
    cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, cr_, cg_, cb_, a)
    cairo_move_to(cr, pts[i][1], pts[i][2])
    cairo_line_to(cr, pts[i + 1][1], pts[i + 1][2])
    cairo_stroke(cr)
  end
end

draw_strand(0, ar, ag, ab)
draw_strand(math.pi, br, bg, bb)
